rows.name: Shedding what a witness holds, slot by slot
rows.definition: Each slot a witness can hold is shed its own way, and only against witnesses who have not yet told anyone: the coat (change it at the office), the car (the second car, the roof sign off, new plates or a respray), the face (a cap and scarf at night, a barber for a week), the companion (walking apart from Ron), the weapon (got rid of). Tom's guess of what each person holds of him shows in words on the Ledger's People page, never as icons (raised by Y1.4, Y2.2; idea 1).
